model: WebMaster / WebMaster ONE (WM1) Modbus TCP/IP option
applies_to: Walchem WebMaster and WebMaster ONE controllers with the Modbus TCP/IP option, software s800/s801/s802/s811/s830 v017 and higher, per manual 180422 Rev G.
summary: WebMaster controllers manage cooling tower and boiler water chemistry. The Modbus TCP/IP option makes the controller a Modbus TCP server on port 502 with read (FC3) and write (FC6/FC16) of holding registers. This map covers the header strings, the live sensor, analog input, digital input and analog output values, and the writable alarm set points of the four direct sensor inputs.

addressing.note: Sections 4.5.1 and 4.6.1 state that the published addresses are 1-based and the packet is 0-based; subtract 1 on the wire (sensor 1 calibrated value 3001 / 43001 is wire address 3000).

source.title: WebMaster / WebMaster ONE Modbus TCP/IP Option Instruction Manual
source.pages: pp. 5-8 (encoding, addressing, header strings), p. 13 (dynamic data), p. 14 (direct sensor set points)

notes: Floats use Walchem's 'float inverse' format: the two words are swapped, so 5000.0 (0x459C4000) arrives as 0x4000 0x459C - low word first (CDAB).
Digital input states are single bits: the manual's 'register/bit' notation counts bits 1-16 from the least significant bit, so '/1' is bit 0 and '/9' is bit 8 here.

Left out: the status, relay hand-off-auto and relay output state registers (2002-2144). The manual calls them 32-bit integers but lists a size of 1 word and an example that reads 1 register, so the register that holds the value is unclear.
Left out: the bit-packed alarm registers (1001-1058); several alarm rows share registers with different bit positions per hardware variant and could not be transcribed reliably.
Left out: analog input, digital input, analog output and relay set points (20001+, 20881+, 23601+, relay tables) - their meaning depends on the configured input/output type.
Values only exist for hardware that is installed; e.g. analog inputs need the analog input card and DI_A..DI_F depend on the controller variant.

integration.summary: Connect to port 502 with unit ID 1, read holding registers with FC3 in blocks of up to 125, and decode floats as CDAB. Poll no faster than every 4 seconds; set points are written as 2-register CDAB floats with FC16.

minimum_registers.why: Sensor input 1 low alarm set point
Sensor input 1 high alarm set point

integration.enable: The Modbus TCP/IP option must be installed/enabled on the WebMaster; set point writes need software v14 or higher.
integration.watchdog: An idle TCP connection is closed after 1 minute of inactivity; up to 10 connections are accepted.
quirks: Unit ID 0 is treated as broadcast and gets no reply.
setup: Network settings are configured through the WebMaster browser interface.
Read up to 125 registers per request.
gotchas: Data refreshes every 4 seconds; faster polling only returns the same values.
Modbus RTU is not supported; serial masters need a TCP gateway.
